EON Raises $10.75 Million in Seed Funding from General Catalyst and A16z to Move Terrestrial Data Across Oceans
EON is building a resilient layer for intercontinental data to augment existing subsea capacity: faster to deploy, harder to disrupt + free from the physical limitations of traditional long-haul network capacity
Source:
https://x.com/presser_tyler/status/2084625057310216669

tweet.text:
Today we're coming out of stealth with a $10.75M seed co-led by @generalcatalyst and @a16z with support from @mainobjectvc , @xyz_vc , and @upfrontvc.

Global internet data moves the same way it did 30 years ago. 95% of intercontinental data runs through subsea cables that take a decade to build and get severed with zero consequence - the Red Sea, the Baltic, Taiwan, over and over.

@EndeavorSpace moves terrestrial data across oceans. A beam up to a satellite, a beam back to Earth. Nothing on the seabed.

The world has changed, we are building the infrastructure to keep up.

We're hiring.
